obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals (worked example)
trigger: Breach of security involving personal information of Florida residents. In this scenario: face templates of about 1,900 pilot enrollees, treated as biometric data (501.171(1)(g)1.a.(VI); whether templates computed from camera video fall under the 501.702 exclusion is unsettled, counsel to confirm). Badge records (name, employer, photo, credential number, access history) are generally not personal information under 501.171 alone; whether access history counts as geolocation information is a question for counsel
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination of a breach or reason to believe a breach occurred; 15 more days only with good cause given to the Department in writing within the 30 days
notify: Each affected Florida resident, by mail or email, with the content in 501.171(4)(e)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - face templates (about 1,900, all at the 2 Florida pilot towers)
notifying_entity: Cris Santos Properties, LLC (Group Chief Privacy Officer with counsel)

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs (worked example)
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination (the 15-day extension does not apply to this notice)
notify: Florida Department of Legal Affairs, with the content in 501.171(3)(b)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 1,900 Floridians

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies (worked example)
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - about 1,900 notices

trigger: A law enforcement agency determines in writing that individual notice would interfere with a criminal investigation
deadline: Delay for the period in the written request
notify: Hold individual notices; keep the request
applies_at_this_tier: Only if requested in writing

applies_at_this_tier: Not triggered by this incident. Applies to Construction federal contracts (see the 14 cameras, P03 CN-G-030)
